en:
What is this place...?
Is this like...a casino?
Why, hello bear!

THIS-PLACE-IS-NOT-*LIKE*-A-CASINO.
IT-*IS*-A-CASINO.
Yeah, yeah! This place is a casino!

YOU-CAN-EARN-LOTS-OF-MONOCOINS-AND-
EXCHANGE-THEM-FOR-FABULOUS-PRIZES...
Yep, yep! You sure can!

That was wonderfully amateurish, Monodam!
It had a flavor not even Father could match!
In a sense, you've surpassed Daddy.

Which makes you a grampa, Monodam!
Grampa Monodam!

<CLT=cltMIND>A casino...?
Why is a casino in a place like this...?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Welcome, welcome!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>At the casino, you can use special
<CLT=cltSTRONG>casino coins<CLT=cltSYSTEM> to play various games.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You can exchange Monocoins for
coins at the <CLT=cltSTRONG>cashier<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Once you exchange them, they can't be
exchanged back! So know what you're doing!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>By now you should be able to see
how many coins you have...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>The coins you've saved up can be exchanged for
<CLT=cltSTRONG>fabulous prizes<CLT=cltSYSTEM> at the <CLT=cltSTRONG>prize exchange counter<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>We're always getting new prizes in,
so look forward to that!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>There are games for you to try in the
basement! Go ahead!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Let's play!
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's so clunky...
I wonder if that's just what Monokuma likes.
